# Review - PR 271 @ 68151428cd78769561c0d51a3ac92f7666e5e7a7

Independent review by a Claude Opus helper (owner-authorized 2026-09-17); no author, fixer or prior reviewer context reused. Trusted prompt, persona and policy ref: `cb347ad6ca23784e03df92979bd93f42c585f202`. Small main-relative change (base `main`, merge-base `92b252ed4bb1860b12a0a6c96084512f53ae9e10`): +129/-2 over three files, adding the auxiliary module `Observables/IdealPointConsistency.lean` with five perfect-consistency identities for the ideal Pauli point projectors on one EPR pair, its aggregate import, and two visibility changes in `ExpandedDefs.lean`.

## Findings

- [ ] F1 (code; changes) `MIPStarRE/QPBT/Observables/IdealPointConsistency.lean:131` - `tauPointProj_epr_offDiagonal_eq_zero` restates verbatim the already existing `MIPStarRE.QPBT.ProjectiveSetting.tauPoint_offDiagonal_eq_zero` at `MIPStarRE/QPBT/Extraction/NonencodingSupport.lean:83` (same namespace, same binders, same `∑ a, ∑ b, if a = b then 0 else stateQForm (eprState (PauliRegister P)) (heteroKron (tauPointProj W u a) (tauPointProj W u b)) = 0`), with a second independent proof, so the tree now carries two proofs of one statement; this is the reuse-not-duplicate rule of the reviewer persona and of `docs/CONTRIBUTING.md` §5.7, and the same defect class as round-3 F2. Fix: keep exactly one - either delete the private `tauPoint_offDiagonal_eq_zero` and let its three call sites (`NonencodingSupport.lean:111,133,155`) use the new public lemma through an import of the new module, or drop the new theorem and derive the final `consistencyDefect` result from the existing one.
- [ ] F2 (code; changes) `MIPStarRE/QPBT/Observables/ExpandedDefs.lean:402` (and `:411`) - `tauPointProj_nonneg` and `sum_tauPointProj_eq_one` are de-privatized by this PR, but after commit `68151428` removed `tauPointProj_epr_diagonal_eq_one` (the only out-of-file caller, of `sum_tauPointProj_eq_one`) neither has any consumer outside `ExpandedDefs.lean`: their only uses are `ExpandedDefs.lean:432,433,464,484,516`. The widened public surface is now unmotivated dead API, and the PR description still advertises it as reuse. Fix: restore `private` on both declarations and delete the corresponding sentence from the PR description; if either is meant to stay public, give it the formalization-only auxiliary record required by `docs/CONTRIBUTING.md` §5.9.

## Review

Scope checked: the full main-relative diff of all three files, the new module read whole, and the surrounding declarations in `ExpandedDefs.lean`, `ExpandedPlacement.lean`, `PerfectStrategy/Observables.lean` and `Games/Consistency.lean` that it builds on.

Faithfulness: the source assertion is item 1 of `lem:qld-comm-cons` (`references/qpbt-paper/14_analysis_of_the_pauli_basis_test.tex:463`), whose proof at line 489 uses that "the Pauli projections $\{\tau^W_a(\ind_m(u))\}$ are perfectly self-consistent between registers $\alice'$ and $\alice''$"; the eigenbasis locator `04_preliminaries.tex:1101-1161` also checks out. The Lean statements quantify only over domain data (`P : AdmissibleParams`, `W : PauliKind`, `u`, and an arbitrary `Distribution` in the last one), use the actual `tauPointProj`, `eprState`, `heteroKron` and the project's `consistencyDefect` (`Games/Consistency.lean:21`, whose off-diagonal `if a = b then 0 else ...` shape the final `change` matches definitionally), and conclude vanishing off-diagonal weight - no strategy, correlation or proof-obligation hypothesis, no conclusion weakened, and the module docstring explicitly disclaims the approximate part of the lemma. No `sorry`, `admit`, `axiom` or `native_decide` in the diff.

Prior findings: round-3 F1 (duplicate `pauliProj_mul`) and F2 (unused duplicate diagonal identity) are both resolved at this head - `tauPointProj_mul_eq_zero_of_ne` specializes the existing `tauPointProj_mul_tauPointProj`, and `68151428` removes `tauPointProj_epr_diagonal_eq_one`; the PR description no longer claims a new diagonal identity or eigenvector-Gram derivation. F2 above is the residue that removal left behind, and F1 is a duplication the earlier rounds did not compare statement-for-statement.

Verification: `lake env lean MIPStarRE/QPBT/Observables/IdealPointConsistency.lean` in the PR worktree (HEAD equal to the published head) elaborated cleanly with no output; the exact-head status API reports `local-ci/summary` success with all nine contexts green (`build` passed in 499s; `blueprint-render` and `statement-origin` reported as skipped-but-successful). Non-blocking observations, not findings: `tauPointProj_epr_action` and `tauPointProj_mul_eq_zero_of_ne` are one-line specializations used once each, and the `_epr_` infix departs from the neighbouring `_eprState` naming in `ExpandedPlacement.lean` and `LineMeasurement/Projector.lean`. Not checked: no full `lake build`, no blueprint render, no rerun of the rooted axiom audit, and no re-derivation of the imported `epr_action_eq_of_transpose`, `tauPointProj_transpose` or `tauPointProj_mul_tauPointProj`, which are unchanged main code. Prose lane is n/a: the diff touches no blueprint TeX, docs, paper-gap note or audit.

VERDICT: CHANGES_REQUESTED (code=CHANGES_REQUESTED, prose=n/a)
